messages:
ana: heads-up: regen created a small diff but it broke the Java SDK compile and sampleapp integration tests. seems unrelated to feature work.
ruben: paste the diff/logs?
ana: (typo: that's ana :)) here's the failing snippet from CI: 
```
ERROR: Cannot find symbol
  symbol:   class WorkspaceState
  location: package com.redwood.sdk.models
// generated enum renamed `workspace_state` -> `WorkspaceStatus` (camelCase -> PascalCase change)
```
tasha: did the typegen rename the enum? that should be non-breaking if the generator maps names consistently, but some languages use raw enum names in public surface.
ana: typegen diff shows only casing normalization in the OpenAPI -> IR step. it normalized `workspace_state` to `WorkspaceStatus`. TS SDK handled it because we emit string unions, but Java used enum class name, so client code references broke.
ci-bot: regendiff run queued (id 4720). Diff: 12 lines. https://ci.internal/regendiff/4720
ruben: also noticed the release lacked a changelog entry for the SDK bump. release automation allowed pushing SDK 2.7.0 without changelog.
tasha: side note: while investigating, I found an OpenAPI normalization change that added a `X-Request-Client` header as required in one endpoint. sampleapp's integration did not include it and CI started returning 400. the spec change came from an upstream swagger tidy commit that should not have moved to required.
nana: so two unrelated regressions landed together: enum renaming and header requirement. looks like release branch got several small merges.
ruben: actionable: 1) roll back enum rename in codegen for languages that expose enum type names (Java, Go). 2) revert the OpenAPI normalization that made header required and add a unit test to spec-normalizer. 3) add a presubmit that runs `mvn -q -DskipTests=false package` for Java sampleapp and `npm ci && npm run build` for TS sampleapp against generated SDKs. 4) changelog linter as a hard presubmit for any public version bump.
tasha: I'll open TYPEGEN-432 to document language-sensitive naming rules and a test matrix.
nana: I'll prepare hotfix PRs: `hotfix/sdk/java/enum-stability` and `hotfix/spec/optional-headers`. linking in PR description the failing CI logs.
ci-bot: CI artifact: https://ci.internal/builds/79234.
ruben: also add a release automation rule: if multiple unrelated files change in a release PR (typegen output + runtime config), block auto-bump and require manual review. we had two independent small changes slip into same release.
tasha: agreed. I'll update release checklist and add a devex ticket DEVEX-655 for gating and the changelog linter.
nana: PRs opened. test-run locally shows Java sampleapp builds after enum fix. merging hotfixes now and will re-run regendiff.
ci-bot: regendiff result: sampleapp compile passes on hotfix branch. 4720 resolved.
ruben: thanks all. let's monitor downstream packages and add a short blurb in the SDK release notes to mention "minor generator normalization changes may affect typed language enum names" until TYPEGEN-432 is complete.
nana: noted. I'll draft the release note and a tiny sampleapp README addition to show how to quickly verify SDK changes: `./scripts/validate-generated-sdks.sh`
tasha: closing loop: TYPEGEN-432 created, DEVEX-655 created, hotfix merged. :white_check_mark:
